\section{Mathematical Model}

The value $x$ is decomposed as $a + b + c$.

The optimization problem is:

\begin{equation}
\max_{x_{ij}} W = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i
\label{eq:welfare}
\end{equation}

\[
\min_{y_j} C = \sum_{j=1}^{m} y_j
\]

Subject to the balance constraint $q_i^d = q_i^s + \sum_{j \neq i} x_{ji}$.
